no partial write survives crash path in handled exceptions

tasks.description: Commit all staged sync_all file updates as one draft-branch transaction commit.
acceptance: single commit_id returned for a sync_all batch
path-scoped add/commit avoids unrelated staging pollution

tasks.description: Expose POST /api/draft/confirm and POST /api/draft/rollback as canonical routes.
acceptance: draft namespace routes are active and documented
confirm/rollback operate on draft/sandbox

tasks.description: Retain /api/world/confirm and /api/world/rollback as deprecated aliases to avoid abrupt caller breakage.
acceptance: legacy routes delegate to draft handlers
response includes deprecation warning field

tasks.description: Add and run regression tests for sync_all success, atomic conflict failure, and draft confirm/rollback flow.
acceptance: sync_all updates multi-file payload in one draft commit
etag conflict blocks all writes and leaves no commit
confirm merges to mainline and rollback resets draft

tasks.description: Publish minimal OpenAPI JSON containing only sync_all, draft confirm, and draft rollback.
acceptance: contains only 3 draft endpoints
schemas reflect runtime fields and error semantics

tasks.description: Write progress log evidence and close v45 checklist phase.
acceptance: progress includes commands and verification results
all tasks are marked done with timestamps and phase status done

phase_v45_frontend.goal: Build the IDE console shell with strict FSM-driven single-direction data flow and causal draft reviews (Extreme Mechanical Atomic Edition).
